title: Seven course QR codes and ARP practice
details: All seven course codes now install the correct Bricklayer, carpentry or Trowel Occupations route
Seven uploadable QR PNGs now show the course name and manual code below the QR
Each course has a mapped bank of 24 original multiple-choice practice questions
ARP now runs random ten-question mocks with feedback, scoring and a saved best result
Course packs, QR images and all 168 practice questions remain available offline
